scope: One fixed-geometry PBE/PAW static point for tangential Ti-displacement response on the COD 9009647 (11-20) slab; reuse archived same-geometry reference force label for paired response analysis.

method.kpoint_type: standard Monkhorst-Pack using GPAW kpts tuple; no explicit gamma flag or additional shift
method.kpoint_mesh_rationale: 7x2x1 keeps reciprocal spacing at least as dense as the prior 12x2x1 mesh for in-plane lengths 3.0575x17.6235 A; new in-plane lengths are recorded in STRUCTURE_AUDIT.json. No k-point convergence study is implied.

resources.checkpoint_policy: One rotating full-wavefunction single-precision checkpoint every 20 SCF iterations; preserve prior good checkpoint until the new one is hashed and atomically installed; resume only after SHA and geometry validation.
resources.resource_estimate_basis: 120 atoms and 14 k-points compared with archived 96-atom 24-kpoint checkpoint 2,422,680,386 bytes; quadratic atom/k-point scaling estimates 2.65 GB, rounded up to 3.2 GB. Estimate only; actual checkpoint and memory measured at runtime.

authorization.scope: Build and calculate only this one deterministic fixed-geometry response point; preserve the source reference, do not change any data role, and do not run relaxation, MD, fitting, or other DFT points.
